name: Intercultural Communication
description: In today's global and increasingly interdisciplinary environment, the success of ventures in almost any field requires an understanding of intercultural communication and cooperation. This module provides students with key concepts of intercultural communication and insights into how people from different backgrounds interact with each other. Based on the assumption that communication situations in international business settings are influenced by various factors including national, organizational and professional cultures, new media and technologies as well as the communicators’ personalities, students learn to analyze and understand these factors. Furthermore, they develop greater self-awareness of their own cultural behavior and communication style and acquire strategies and techniques to improve their communication skills.
prerequisites:
Some work and/or internship experience
Very good English language skills (C1)
